decision_reason: The dispatched test matrix and self-tests pass, but independent adversarial probes found four blocking control bypasses: the independent-evidence flag is not enforced, post-review descendant code can be merged, merged-state verification accepts self-asserted offline PR metadata without head/main ancestry, and PR repository identity is not bound to origin. Branch evidence remains implemented and independent_evidence=false.

findings.title: independently_verified state is accepted while independent_evidence is false
findings.expected: Pre-merge verification must require independent_evidence to be the boolean true in addition to state=independently_verified.
findings.actual: verify_premerge checks only state. A complete fixture bundle with independent_evidence=false passed verify_branch(..., independently_verified).
findings.impact: The machine-readable independence assertion can remain false while the gate certifies the branch as independently verified.
findings.reproduction: reviewer_adversarial.py probe independent_evidence_false; see reviewer-adversarial.txt line 1.
findings.required_fix: Require evidence.get('independent_evidence') is True before accepting pre-merge state, and add false, missing, null and non-boolean negative tests.

findings.title: Unreviewed descendant commits are accepted and can be recorded as merged
findings.expected: The commit/tree that reaches main must be the reviewed implementation, or every post-source delta must be restricted to explicitly reviewed canonical evidence paths.
findings.actual: After binding source, the probe committed canonical evidence and then an unreviewed fixture.txt code change. verify_premerge, create_merge_record and verify_branch(..., merged) all accepted the descendant head.
findings.impact: A feature branch can add or alter implementation after review and still pass the branch and merge gates.
findings.reproduction: reviewer_adversarial.py probe unreviewed_descendant_head; see reviewer-adversarial.txt line 3. The current PR's 031524f..995c710 delta is evidence-only, but the reusable control does not enforce that restriction.
findings.required_fix: Bind review to the final PR head/tree or enforce a canonical post-source path allowlist with a reviewer-attested delta hash. Reject any post-source implementation change and add a negative merge test.

findings.title: Merged-state gate accepts forged offline PR metadata without head-to-merge or main ancestry
findings.expected: Merged state must be backed by authoritative PR metadata, a PR head contained by the merge commit, and a merge commit reachable from main/origin/main.
findings.actual: record_id is an unkeyed self-hash. verify_merge_record skips PR metadata unless a caller supplies it, checks only source ancestry, and verify_branch calls it without live metadata. A forged record with an attacker PR URL and a side-branch head not ancestral to the merge passed verify_merge_record and verify_branch(..., merged).
findings.impact: A self-consistent local JSON record can certify merged state without a real merge into main.
findings.reproduction: reviewer_adversarial.py probe offline_forged_merge_record; reviewer-adversarial.txt line 5 records side_is_ancestor=False.
findings.required_fix: Make merged-state verification fetch and validate live canonical GitHub metadata by default, require head_oid to be an ancestor of merge_sha, require merge_sha reachable from main/origin/main, and bind the expected merge SHA. Offline checks must not return a merged PASS.

findings.title: PR repository identity is not bound to the configured production origin
findings.expected: A merge record must reference the same GitHub owner/repository as origin; the requested PR must be a canonical URL, not an arbitrary gh selector or option.
findings.actual: PR_URL_RE accepts any GitHub owner/repo and _validate_pr_metadata never compares it with origin. With origin set to swadhinbiswas/pygpui, metadata for attacker/pygpui was accepted by create_merge_record.
findings.impact: A merge in an unrelated repository can satisfy the production merge-record control.
findings.required_fix: Resolve origin to a canonical GitHub owner/repo, require the PR URL to match it, validate the input selector before invoking gh, and add wrong-repository and option-like-input negatives.

findings.title: Bound review and test records may declare contradictory roles
findings.expected: Review and test records must repeat the canonical reviewer/tester role as well as the assigned session ID.
findings.actual: A review record with role=implementer and a test record with role=reviewer passed after their hashes were refreshed.
findings.impact: Canonical independent evidence can contain contradictory role identity even though the session IDs match the registry.
findings.required_fix: Validate normalized record roles against the assigned role and add wrong-role negatives for both records.

findings.title: Red-main drill never makes the fixture remote main red
findings.expected: The isolated drill should exercise a red fixture origin/main and its restoration, not only a red local worktree main.
findings.actual: The only pushes are the initial green baseline and final restored green. red_main_sha is never pushed to the fixture remote.
findings.impact: The drill proves local control flow and production isolation but not remote red-main detection or recovery.
findings.reproduction: reviewer_adversarial.py probe red_main_fixture_remote_never_red; reviewer-adversarial.txt line 6 shows push_count=2 (baseline plus final green).
findings.required_fix: Push the simulated red merge to the fixture remote, assert fixture origin/main equals red_main_sha and fails the gate, then restore and archive both remote states.

findings.title: An existing empty fixture directory raises an unhandled FileExistsError
findings.expected: The documented absent-or-empty fixture contract should accept an existing empty directory or reject it with GateError and a stable CLI exit.
findings.actual: validate_fixture accepts an empty directory, then initialize_fixture calls mkdir without exist_ok and raises FileExistsError.
findings.impact: A valid documented input produces a traceback and exit 1 instead of a controlled result.
findings.required_fix: Create the directory with exist_ok=True after validation, or reject existing directories explicitly with GateError; add a CLI regression test.

findings.title: Canonical README contains stale evidence and count statements
findings.expected: Canonical evidence documentation should match the committed attempt-2 records and current production-main observations.
findings.actual: The README says independent-test.json is absent although it is committed, says review/test/merge records are absent although the test record exists, reports an impossible collected-76/95-passed pair, and cites stale production-main hashes.
findings.impact: Integrators and future reviewers can be misled about which evidence exists and what was observed.
findings.reproduction: Compare the cited README lines with independent-test.json and the reviewer identity logs.
findings.required_fix: Refresh the README from canonical JSON and logs without rewriting preserved attempt-1 evidence.

scope_reviewed: canonical JSON, path containment and duplicate-key handling
subprocess argument construction and dependency errors
registry approval, task-bound roles and session separation
PR/merge identity, live metadata use and merge ancestry
fixture path isolation and production-ref snapshots
error handling, atomic writes and append-only behavior
test mutation coverage, negative cases and documentation consistency
limitations: Review and execution used one Linux runner; no second clean runner or independent static-analysis service was available.
The wrong-repository PR path was exercised with deterministic local metadata rather than by creating an external GitHub repository.
GitHub reported mergeability UNKNOWN at dispatch; no merge was attempted or certified.
Current PR source-to-head changes were inspected and are evidence-only; R-02 concerns the reusable gate's acceptance of future post-review implementation changes.
scope_statement: No implementation, independent-test.json, merge.json, TASKS.json, STATE.md, ADR, main, or UI file was edited. branch-evidence.json remains byte-for-byte unchanged at state=implemented and independent_evidence=false. This review does not authorize merge.
